author: CBR
description:
Avengers: Doomsday directors shut down the popular X-Men movie rumor and explain why Secret Wars was always the real Marvel plan.

The Avengers: Doomsday directors address speculation that their Marvel return was originally going to be an X-Men project. Instead, they say X-Men was “never even discussed,” because the conversation was always centered on Secret Wars. The clip also explains why Secret Wars mattered personally, how the comic shaped their love of Marvel, and why finding a story worthy of following Avengers: Endgame took so long.

This is a quick breakdown for MCU fans tracking Avengers: Doomsday, Avengers: Secret Wars, X-Men rumors, Marvel Studios’ next crossover event, and what the directors’ comments reveal about the future of the MCU.

Andy Serkis explains why playing dark characters is not about labeling them as evil, but finding the humanity that makes audiences think deeper. In this Heroes Journey Podcast clip, Serkis talks about dark roles, allegorical storytelling, and why difficult characters can affect viewers in a more profound way.
